name: @six5536/sokf-workspace
description: sokf validates knowledge stores in the Superdev Open Knowledge Format (SOKF): directories of Markdown documents with YAML frontmatter, which sokf checks against their schemas.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:linux-x64 && npm run build:linux-arm64 && npm run build:darwin-x64 && npm run build:darwin-arm64
scripts.build:linux-x64: rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl -p sokf && install -m 0755 target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/sokf packages/sokf-linux-x64/bin/sokf
scripts.build:linux-arm64: rustup target add aarch64-unknown-linux-musl && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl -p sokf && install -m 0755 target/aarch64-unknown-linux-musl/release/sokf packages/sokf-linux-arm64/bin/sokf
scripts.build:darwin-x64: rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin -p sokf && install -m 0755 target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/sokf packages/sokf-darwin-x64/bin/sokf
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin -p sokf && install -m 0755 target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/sokf packages/sokf-darwin-arm64/bin/sokf
